description: Get an overview of a type of product in Spanish online shops: how many products and shops SeeStocks tracks, the price range (minimum, 10th percentile, median, 90th percentile, maximum), the cheapest products, the products sold by most shops and the biggest real price drops of the last 30 days. Use it for broad shopping questions ('robot aspirador barato', 'how much does an air fryer cost', 'which above-ground pools are on sale') rather than for one specific model. Pass `consulta` with the type of product in Spanish (e.g. 'freidora de aire', 'robot aspirador'); the category is detected with SeeStocks' search. If `categoria` is not what the user means, call again with `id_categoria` taken from `ruta` (broader) or `subcategorias` (narrower). Optional filters: price range in euros and brand. With `consulta`, the lists only hold products of the category that match the query (`listas_de` = 'consulta'); the price figures always cover the whole category. Lists leave out spare parts and accessories when `excluye_accesorios` is true. Each product has an `id` for ficha_producto. Prices are in euros; `envio_eur` null means unknown, not free.

consulta.description: Type of product in Spanish, e.g. 'freidora de aire'.
consulta.title: Consulta

id_categoria.description: Category id from a previous answer (ruta or subcategorias).
id_categoria.title: Id Categoria

marca.description: Brand name, only if the user names a brand.
marca.title: Marca

name: explorar_categoria
title: Explore a product category
